Definition: ordinal from G5140; third; neuter (as noun) a third part, or (as adverb) a (or the) third time, thirdly:--third(-ly).
BiblicalUsage: God set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, and Paul knew a man caught up to the third heaven. God set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, and Paul knew a man caught up to the third heaven, whether in the body or out of it he could not tell.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word holds the church's order and the apostle's mystery together: third is a real rank, and the third heaven is a real place.
